params.1274: You need crossbow strings, iron bars and willow logs.
params.1275: You can get crossbow strings by using raw beef on an oven and selecting 'sinew'. Then you can use the sinew on a spinning wheel to get the string.
params.1276: You can fletch crossbow stocks from logs.
params.1277: You can smith crossbow limbs from metal bars.
params.1278: Use the crossbow limbs on the crossbow stock to create an unstrong crossbow. Use a crossbow string on the unstrung crossbow to finish your crossbow.
